description: Group spec versions by API product (Twilio subproducts, Azure services, GitHub GHES variants) so multi-product providers are navigable. Twilio currently shows 159 flat versions; post-fix shows ~15 product groups each with their own version list.

phases.name: Domain: product extractor
phases.description: Pure-domain function mapping (url, label, providerSlug) to an ApiProduct {key, name}. Handles Twilio spec/json/twilio_<product>_v<N>.json, GitHub descriptions/<variant>/, Azure specification/<service>/, Google Cloud googleapis.com/<service>/, Cloudflare api-schemas/<product>/, and a generic directory-name fallback. Includes groupByProduct helper that returns a single 'All versions' group when <2 distinct products are found (single-product providers like Stripe/OpenAI fall through to flat list).

tasks.name: Create src/core/domain/product-extractor.ts
tasks.description: extractProduct(url,label,slug)->ApiProduct|undefined plus groupByProduct helper. Zero external imports. Unit-testable pure functions.

tasks.name: Sync lib/domain mirror
tasks.description: Run bun run sync:lib so src/lib/domain/product-extractor.js is regenerated for the React adapter (ADR-012 NodeNext .js imports).

phases.name: Primary adapter: two-tier VersionPicker
phases.description: Wire groupByProduct into src/components/sidebar/VersionPicker.jsx. Render a product selector above the v1/v2 dropdowns when >1 product is detected, else keep the existing flat shape. Selected product filters the v1/v2 option lists. Cross-product comparison is disabled (pick two versions of the same product). Persist last-selected product per provider in localStorage('apidiff:lastProduct:<slug>').

tasks.name: Group versions by product in VersionPicker
tasks.description: Import groupByProduct from @/lib/domain/product-extractor.js. Compute groups = groupByProduct(versions, provider.slug). When groups.length > 1 render a product <select> above the v1/v2 row; the v1/v2 selects iterate only the chosen group's versions. Disable Compare button until both selections are within the same product (always true now since selects are scoped). When groups.length === 1, render the existing flat layout unchanged.

tasks.name: Persist last-selected product per provider
tasks.description: On product change, write localStorage('apidiff:lastProduct:<provider.slug>', productKey). On provider change / initial mount, read it back and default the product selector to that value if the group still exists. Silently ignore localStorage errors (SSR / private mode).

tasks.name: Dark-mode parity for product selector
tasks.description: New <select> must match existing v1/v2 selects' dark: variants (bg-white dark:bg-stone-800, border-stone-200 dark:border-stone-700, text-stone-700 dark:text-stone-200).
